title_tr: İş yükü raporu tamamlanmış görevleri de sayıyor
issue: The workload report counts tasks that are already DONE, so people who finished their work still look busy. Only open tasks should be counted.

bug.replace:
OPEN_STATUSES = frozenset({Status.TODO, Status.IN_PROGRESS, Status.BLOCKED, Status.IN_REVIEW,
                           Status.DONE})

ground_truth.root_cause: OPEN_STATUSES in tasks/models.py includes Status.DONE; ProjectReports.workload counts tasks whose status is in OPEN_STATUSES, so done tasks are counted.
